The '''sandbug''' was a type of creature. In the cuisine of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], sandbugs were eaten live in a dish that also included [[Spice/Legends|spiced]], boiled meat and [[schinga]] scales.<ref name="SP">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], Prologue</ref>
